narration.en: Breakdown destroys an ordinary diode. A Zener diode is built to live in breakdown, and that is exactly what makes it hold a voltage steady.
narration.kn: ಸ್ಥಗಿತ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಡಯೋಡ್ ಅನ್ನು ಹಾಳುಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಜೀನರ್ ಡಯೋಡ್ ಸ್ಥಗಿತದಲ್ಲೇ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವಂತೆ ತಯಾರಾಗಿದೆ; ಅದೇ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ಅನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: A Zener diode is a heavily doped silicon diode designed to work in reverse breakdown. In heavily doped junctions (breakdown below about 5 V) the strong field across the thin depletion layer pulls electrons straight out of covalent bonds: Zener breakdown. In lightly doped junctions (above about 6 V) carriers gain enough energy to knock out more carriers by collision: avalanche breakdown. In breakdown the voltage stays nearly constant at V_Z over a wide range of current, up to I_Z(max) = P_Z/V_Z.

points.en: Zener effect: heavy doping, V_Z below ~5 V
Avalanche: lighter doping, V_Z above ~6 V
In breakdown, V ≈ V_Z for a wide range of I

narration.en: A Zener diode is heavily doped and designed to work in reverse breakdown, where its voltage stays almost constant over a wide range of current.
narration.kn: ಜೀನರ್ ಡಯೋಡ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಡೋಪ್ ಮಾಡಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿದ್ದು ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ಸ್ಥಗಿತದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಅದರ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ವಿಶಾಲ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹುತೇಕ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Zener diode as a voltage regulator

say.en: The Zener diode works in reverse breakdown. Past the Zener voltage the current can change a lot while the voltage hardly changes.
The regulator: a series resistor R from the supply, the Zener reverse-biased across the load.
The series current divides: part through the Zener, part through the load.
The rules: the series current is the input minus V Z, over R. The Zener current is the series current minus the load current.

narration.en: On the board: Zener diode as a voltage regulator.

A 5.1 V Zener, reverse biased, sits across the load with a series resistor R. While it is in breakdown the output stays at 5.1 V: the Zener takes whatever current the load does not need, IZ = IS − IL. If the input is too low, or the load too heavy, the Zener stops regulating.
narration.kn: 5.1 V ಜೀನರ್ ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ಬಯಾಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮಾಂತರವಾಗಿದೆ. ಭಂಗದಲ್ಲಿರುವವರೆಗೆ ನಿರ್ಗಮ 5.1 V; IZ = IS − IL. ಒಳಹರಿವು ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾದರೆ ಅಥವಾ ಭಾರ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದರೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Zener as a shunt voltage regulator

body.en: The Zener is reverse-biased in parallel with the load, and a series resistor R drops the extra voltage. The series current is $I_S = (V_{in} - V_Z)/R$, the load current $I_L = V_Z/R_L$, and the Zener takes the rest: $I_Z = I_S - I_L$. If the input rises or the load current falls, the Zener simply takes more current, and the output stays at V_Z.

points.en: Output stays at V_Z while I_Z stays within limits

narration.en: In the regulator the series current is the input minus V Z over R, and the Zener takes whatever the load does not. So the output stays at V Z.
narration.kn: ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಣಿ ಪ್ರವಾಹ = (Vin − Vz)/R; ಲೋಡ್ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳದ ಉಳಿದ ಪ್ರವಾಹವನ್ನು ಜೀನರ್ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ Vz ನಲ್ಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Below about 5 V: Zener effect (heavy doping, field pulls electrons out; V_Z falls slightly as temperature rises). Above about 6 V: avalanche (collisions; V_Z rises with temperature). Around 5–6 V the two balance, giving the best temperature stability.

narration.en: Zener or avalanche?. Below about 5 V: Zener effect (heavy doping, field pulls electrons out; V_Z falls slightly as temperature rises). Above about 6 V: avalanche (collisions; V_Z rises with temperature). Around 5–6 V the two balance, giving the best temperature stability.

mnemonic.en: Five and below: Zener; six and above: avalanche
